bodyMarkdown:
## Understanding the Marine Technician Salary

If you are looking up a **marine technician salary**, the most relevant modern award is the Marine Tourism and Charter Vessels Award 2020 (MA000093). This award covers roles such as engineers, deckhands, and masters on charter vessels. A common classification for a marine technician is Engineer MED III, which under the award has a minimum hourly rate of **$30.49** for a full-time non-overnight charter employee.

To convert this hourly rate to an annual figure, use the standard formula: **hourly rate × hours per week × 52**. Assuming a 38-hour week (the ordinary hours for full-time employees under the award), the calculation is:

$30.49 × 38 × 52 = **$60,248.24 per year**.

This is the gross annual salary before tax and super. The fortnightly equivalent is $30.49 × 38 × 2 = **$2,317.24**.

### Award Rates vs National Minimum Wage

The National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is **$26.44 per hour** or $1,004.90 per week for 38 hours [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage). A marine technician salary under the award is higher than the minimum, reflecting the skilled nature of the work. The award also provides higher rates for higher classifications such as Master IV ($31.05 per hour) and Engineer MED I ($34.14 per hour).

For casual employees, the award includes a 25% casual loading. The casual hourly rate for Engineer MED III is **$38.11**, which already includes the loading. When using the [timesheet](/), never add casual loading on top of a rate that already includes it.

### Tax and Super Considerations

Using the 2026–27 resident tax rates, a marine technician earning $60,248 would pay:
- Nil on the first $18,200
- 15% on the next $26,800 ($4,020)
- 30% on the remaining $15,248 ($4,574.40)
- Total tax: **$8,594.40**
- Medicare levy (2%): **$1,204.96**
- Estimated take-home pay: **$50,448.88 per year** (about $4,204 per month or $970 per week).

Superannuation guarantee is **12% of ordinary earnings**, paid on top of your salary. For $60,248, that is an extra **$7,229.76** contributed to your super fund each year, subject to the $270,830 maximum contribution base. See [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) for more details.

### Using the Timesheet Calculator

To calculate your own marine technician salary, enter your base hourly rate into the [timesheet](/). The tool assumes a 38-hour week and 52 weeks per year. You can also check the [pay guides](/blog) for the latest award rates from the Fair Work Ombudsman.

### Summary

A marine technician salary under the Marine Tourism Award is well above the National Minimum Wage. For a full-time Engineer MED III, expect around **$60,248 per year** before tax, with super paid on top. Casual employees earn a higher hourly rate but do not receive paid leave. Always refer to the official award or the Fair Work Commission’s Modern Awards Pay Database for the most accurate rates.
